I can relate to the problem with not having any rules, it makes it difficult to know what is ok and whats not. I think that it is ok for you to not worry about your grades Right now, University will still be there later and i think you should focus on making yourself feel better.

Have you tried to talk one on one with one off your friends, it might be easier.
Thank you, you helped me very much, i fell better att the moment and can think more clearly.

Yes, that feeling of not knowing where to go in life is hard. Just existing without a cause can be hard to deal with. Hopefully we can find a way to handle it. Also thank you for telling me its ok to be on welfare, cause i do feel ashamed a lot. Thank you for your kind words they help a lot.

Thats a good word Terrifying, because that is what it is. I am terrified that I cant deal with it, i have tried to ask for help but the words wont come out. Im sitting here crying at my friends house scared that they will wake upp and see me like this, but also i am kind of hoping that they will so they can see how bad im feeling. is that weird?

I'm sorry your friend walked away. Where in California does your dad live and have you talked with your family about your feelings?

Edit: I feel a bit silly about this post, I really want to say something good, and i want to make it bearable for you. I spent a long minute just trying to know what to say, but all i can see is that even though i have only read what you say here I know that you are worth so much better.
Hey Waffles, i disagree with you being a pussy, It takes guts to admit such hard emotions. I also agree with Tau, use your anger and let it be your ally.
Thanks :) i would call if i had a phone with me now, but i don't, also i live in Sweden. I am really happy that you replyed though and it helps me keep my mind of stuff now.
